title_working: The Smallest Kid In School Just Jumped Onto The Gym Roof
world_rule: Nico can jump higher than any human, but promised his mum to keep it secret.
logline: The smallest kid in school breaks a promise to his mum to prove himself, and she smiles.

look.clothes: cyan T-shirt with a yellow lightning bolt, dark jeans, big red sneakers

locations: school field with bleachers, high-jump bar and mat, tall gym building with a flat roof

lines.text: The smallest kid in school just jumped onto the gym roof.
lines.say: (confident) The smallest kid in school just jumped onto the gym roof.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Extreme close-up of Nico's smirking face; flash cut to the gym roof high above.

lines.text: Nico had a secret gift. He could jump higher than a house.
lines.say: (calm) Nico had a secret gift. He could jump higher than a house.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Flashback (warm tint): little Nico bounds from the floor onto the kitchen table, then up to a high shelf.

lines.text: His mum made him promise: never use it where anyone can see.
lines.say: (calm)(soft tone) His mum made him promise: never use it where anyone can see.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up: his mum, serious, holds his shoulders; he nods slowly.

lines.text: So at school, he was only the tiny kid nobody noticed.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) So at school, he was only the tiny kid nobody noticed.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hallway: Nico walks alone, kids walk past without looking at him.

lines.text: At the jump contest, the crowd snickered as Nico took his place.
lines.say: (calm) At the jump contest, the crowd snickered as Nico took his place.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Field wide: bleachers full, the crowd snickering; Nico tiny beside the tall bar.

lines.text: Chase, the star jumper, had won three years in a row. The trophy was practically his.
lines.say: (nervous) Chase, the star jumper, had won three years in a row. The trophy was practically his.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Chase flexes, low-angle close-up; the crowd chants his name.

lines.text: Each athlete got one jump. Just one.
lines.say: (worried) Each athlete got one jump. Just one.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Coach Reyes holds up one finger; a sign reads ONE JUMP.

lines.text: Chase soared over the bar. A new school record. The stands exploded.
lines.say: (surprised) Chase soared over the bar. A new school record. The stands exploded.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Chase soars over the bar (a sign: 2 m RECORD); the crowd erupts.

lines.text: Then someone behind him whispered, "Why is he even here?"
lines.say: (nervous)(soft tone) Then someone behind him whispered, "Why is he even here?"
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Over-the-shoulder: a kid in the crowd whispers; Nico's fists tighten.

lines.text: Nico remembered his promise. Then he decided to break it.
lines.say: (confident)(soft tone) Nico remembered his promise. Then he decided to break it.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up: Nico's eyes narrow; a flash of his mum's face; he lifts his chin.

lines.text: He barely bent his knees.
lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) He barely bent his knees.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Extreme close-up of Nico's sneakers on the mat; the cheering fades.

lines.text: Then the ground cracked under his feet.
lines.say: (nervous)(soft tone) Then the ground cracked under his feet.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Low angle: a crack spreads under Nico's shoes; a beat of silence.

lines.text: He crouched, pushed off, and shot into the sky like a rocket.
lines.say: (surprised) He crouched, pushed off, and shot into the sky like a rocket.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Nico crouches, launches; the camera follows and tilts up fast past the bar, the flagpole, the sky.

lines.text: Nico was waving down from the gym roof.
lines.say: (surprised) Nico was waving down from the gym roof.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Low-angle from the field: tiny Nico on the roof edge against the sun, waving.

lines.text: Nobody breathed.
lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) Nobody breathed.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Wide: a frozen crowd, mouths open; Chase's gold headband slips off.

lines.text: Coach Reyes unrolled her tape with shaking hands.
lines.say: (surprised) Coach Reyes unrolled her tape with shaking hands.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up of Coach Reyes with the tape; her hands tremble.

lines.text: Twenty meters. The old record was two.
lines.say: (surprised) Twenty meters. The old record was two.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Board: OLD RECORD 2 m, NEW 20 m.

lines.text: Nobody snickered anymore. They chanted his name.
lines.say: (happy) Nobody snickered anymore. They chanted his name.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hallway and field: kids gather around Nico, chanting, smiling.

lines.text: Even Chase clapped.
lines.say: (calm)(soft tone) Even Chase clapped.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up: Chase, humbled, slowly claps.

lines.text: And his mum? She had watched it all from the stands. She just smiled.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) And his mum? She had watched it all from the stands. She just smiled.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up of his mum, wiping a tear, smiling; the crowd cheers around her.

lines.text: The smallest kid in school was never small again.
lines.say: (confident)(soft tone) The smallest kid in school was never small again.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hero low-angle shot: Nico against the bright sky.

changes_from_previous: QA v1 (originality 4) fixes: ALL phrasing rebuilt in new sentence shapes (no 'ever since X was five', 'a second later', 'three times ... broken ... but it wasn't', 'ten times the school record', 'from that day on ... highest human alive'); 'laughed' removed; sentences <=14 words; new decision beat (a whispered 'Why is he even here?' triggers the broken promise); title and line 1 now say 'onto the gym roof' to match the picture; jump arc shown (crouch, launch, tilt); the proof is told with a tape and numbers (twenty metres vs two); rival concedes; the mum smiles; the last line echoes the title.
